versions.changelog:
- Initial release of fingerprint-ci-gate.
- Enables CI/CD gating on browser fingerprint regressions using liarjs.
- Supports both absolute score floors and baseline diffing to detect fingerprint changes.
- Designed for integration with GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or other CI pipelines.
- Provides guidance for storing and comparing fingerprint scan artifacts.
- Offers offline mode and customizable endpoints for secure environments.
